name: Smith.ai
positioning: A North America-based receptionist service offering both human-staffed answering and an AI receptionist that can hand off to live agents, billed per call.

pricing.model: Monthly plan with a bundle of calls, billed per call (not per minute), plus per-call add-ons. Two product lines: AI-first and human-first.
pricing.headline: AI receptionist: Free (25 calls), Pro from $150/mo (75 calls, $2.00/call), Enterprise from $500/mo (300 calls). Human receptionists: $300/mo (30 calls), $810/mo (90), $2,100/mo (300).
planNotes: AI Pro: $150/mo for 75 calls, $270 for 150, $500 for 300 (per-call $2.00 / $1.80 / $1.67); extra calls $2.50-$2.17.
AI Enterprise: $500/mo for 300 calls, $800 for 500, custom for 1000+.
Human plans carry a 30-day money-back refund window; month to month; 10% off for 12-month commitment on human plans.
AI plans: calls count toward quota by default, with an allowance to remove up to 10% as spam.
pricing.freeTrial: AI Receptionist free tier, 25 calls a month ('free forever' on the homepage).
whatIsExtra: Per-call add-ons on human plans (booking $1.50, recording $0.25, extended intake $1.50, Spanish line $1.00, payments $1.00 and others).
Per-month extras on human plans (business caller ID $10, extra transfer destinations $15, tracking numbers $5 each).

strengths.claim: Combines AI answering with live North America-based receptionists who can take over complex calls at any hour.
Free AI tier with 25 calls a month and a testing studio, so businesses can try before paying.
Per-call billing, with spam excluded on human plans and an allowance for spam on AI plans.
Integrations with CRMs and scheduling tools (for example HubSpot, Salesforce, Clio, Calendly) plus Zapier.
Long track record: homepage cites 25M+ calls handled over 11+ years, with a strong focus on law firms and home services.

limitations.claim: Human-staffed plans start at $300/month for 30 calls, and many features (booking, recording, extended intake) are priced as per-call add-ons.

compliance.note: No HIPAA, SOC 2 or GDPR statement was found on the pricing, homepage or integrations pages read. Unknown, not a negative.

telephony.providedNumbers: Human plans include a dedicated local or toll-free number, or you can port your business number at no charge. AI plan number handling not detailed on pages read.

stepsToLeave: There is no customer-built agent to export: Smith.ai staff or its AI are configured for you (greetings, intake questions, routing rules), so these are recreated in the new platform.
Numbers: a dedicated Smith.ai number can be replaced by porting your own business number in, which the vendor says is free; the reverse (porting out) is not described on pages read.
Call recordings and transcripts are available on human plans as an add-on ($0.25/call); CRM and Zapier connections send call details to your own systems.
Cancellation: human plans bill through the end of the monthly cycle; AI plans need 30 days' notice.

bestFor: Professional-services firms (law, home services) that want live humans available alongside AI and are comfortable with per-call pricing.
unknowns: Whether numbers can be ported out.
Whether recordings and transcripts are exportable in bulk on AI plans.
